about_the_game:
Two crews, one lively city, and a whole lot of “whaaat ?!” In LootScoot, Thieves sprint for big payouts while Cops try to shut the show down. With gadgets, teamwork, and a dose of chaos. It’s bright, cheeky, and built for quick, replayable matches where every corner can flip the script.

Choose Your Fun

Thieves

Sneak into shops, grab the cash, and deliver it to a hidden contact before the sirens catch up. Bigger hauls paint a bigger target—so plan your route, use disguises, and let your friends create “accidental” distractions.

Cops

Patrol hot spots, read the map, and pounce on suspicious movement. Box in suspects, cut off escape lanes, and coordinate takedowns to keep the streets in one piece (more or less).

How You Win

  • Thieves win by hitting the cash goal before the timer runs out.

  • Cops win if the clock hits zero and the thieves come up short, late game helicopters make hiding a lot harder.

WE NEED YOU !! 

Big Boss:

“Think fast, look normal, and bring home something shiny. My crew loves a generous rookie.”

Sheriff:

"Badge up, rookie. The city’s loud, the streets are wild, and we’re here to make it a good day.”

Pick a side, grab your friends, and dive into a playful cops-and-robbers sprint where every match tells a new “you had to be there” story.

name: Loot Scoot

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: LootScoot is a fast, team-based cops-and-robbers game. Thieves break into shops and deliver cash; Cops patrol, chase, and arrest. Beat the clock with chaotic plays or go stealth and slip past patrols. Pick a side, outsmart the other, and sprint for the win.
